title: Card 6: har tukde ka leader + 2 copy (ISR). acks=all: saari copy le lein tab OK. Leader gira to copy se naya leader

boxes.title: Controller (KRaft)
lines: ek hi faisla, do leader nahi

callouts.red: Sirf leader pe likh ke "ho gaya" bol do (acks=1)?
callouts.green: Leader ne OK bola aur copy banne se pehle mar gaya: Arpan ki khabar gayi

callouts.red: Dopahar Broker A ki disk mar gayi
callouts.green: Controller copy wali B ko naya leader banata. Arpan ki khabar B aur C pe bachi thi

callouts.red: Copy wali machine bhi kam pad gayi (sirf 1 bachi)
callouts.green: min.insync=2: tab likhna hi band. Khabar khone se behtar hai thodi der rukna

callouts.red: Peeche chal rahi copy ko leader bana do? Nahi, uske paas aakhri khabar nahi. 3 copy ke liye kam se kam 3 machine.
callouts.green: acks = kitni jagah likh ke "ho gaya": 0 = bhej ke bhool jao · 1 = sirf leader (click, log) · all = saari copy (paisa, order)

callouts.red: Pehle poochho: khabar kho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi?
callouts.green: Isi jawab se acks tay hota

kyun: Arpan ki khabar teen machine pe likhi jaati: leader A aur do copy B, C. "Ho gaya" tabhi bolte jab copy pe bhi likh gayi (acks=all). A mari to copy wali B naya leader banti, khabar bachi rehti
peeche: card 5 me har service ka apna group
ab: Dopahar Broker A ki disk mari, Arpan ki khabar usi pe thi
agla: ab broker pe to bach gaya, consumer pe kho sakta? (card 7)
